# Staying Alert and Vigilant
## Scripture
"Put on the whole armor of God, that you may be able to stand against the schemes of the devil." – Ephesians 6:11

## Reflection
As men of faith, we are in a constant battle against the forces of darkness. Satan seeks to deceive and destroy us, but we are not unarmed. We have the full armor of God at our disposal, including the belt of truth, the breastplate of righteousness, and the shield of faith. But we must stay alert and vigilant, always ready to defend ourselves against the enemy's attacks. This means being aware of our thoughts and actions, and making sure we are living in accordance with God's Word. It means being honest with ourselves and others, and being willing to make the necessary sacrifices to follow Jesus. By staying alert and vigilant, we can stand strong against the schemes of the devil and live a victorious life in Christ.

## Daily Challenge
"March in place for 1 minute while repeating 'I am strong in the Lord and in the power of His might.'"
